Bash(git -C "D:\\github_repository\\fanfic-lab" commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: prevent cache check timer from being cancelled \(v4.0\)

Root cause: React''s useEffect cleanup was clearing the timer when
dependencies like appendMessage changed reference between renders.
The 300ms timer never completed, so checkCache never executed.

Fix:
- Use refs to store callback functions \(appendMessage, onComplete, etc.\)
- Minimal dependencies in main init effect \(only sourceName, sourceType\)
- hasInitializedRef ensures one-time execution even if cleanup runs
- Reduced timer delay from 300ms to 100ms

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.com/claude-code\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
